Name: Jabez
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed in the vicinity of Bethlehem or of Arad
Description: A town where families of scribes dwelt, the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Suchathites, counted among the Kenites in Judah's genealogies.
BiblicalSignificance: Jabez is remembered for its scribes: a town of writers in a genealogy of warriors and kings.
